embeds.title: <a:1084504000231120976:1154864108450095127> Discord Etiquette: Rules and Expectations! <a:1084504000231120976:1154864108450095127>
embeds.description:
> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>** No Spamming**

> - Please keep the chat free of spam. This includes excessive use of emojis, repeated messages, or off-topic comments.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**  Respect All Members**
 
> - Treat everyone with kindness and respect. No trolling, bullying, or harassing other members. If you disagree with someone, do so respectfully.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**  No NSFW Content** 

> - This is a SFW (Safe For Work) server. Please refrain from sharing or discussing any NSFW content.

 > <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>** Stay on Topic** 

> - Each channel has a purpose. Please stick to the channel's topic when posting or commenting.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**  No External Links** 

> - Do not post unsolicited links, whether they're promotional, potentially harmful, or off-topic. If you want to share a link, consult an admin or mod first.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**  Avoid Sharing Personal Info** 

> - For your safety, never share personal or confidential information on this server.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**  Disclaimer** 

> - Our admins and mods will NEVER ask you for any confidential information. Report suspicious activity immediately.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**   Beware of Scammers** 

> - Be cautious of unsolicited messages, especially if they seem too good to be true.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**   Follow Discord’s ToS** 

> - Ensure you are familiar with and adhere to Discord's Terms of Service.

> <a:1124333533553504296:1156989872716914840>**   Consequences** 

> - Failing to follow these rules may lead to warnings, mutes, kicks, or bans.

> - **Remember, this space is for everyone. Let's keep it safe and respectful!  **
